claim: MITRE ATT&CK is a knowledge base of attacker behaviour
quote: MITRE ATT&CK is a curated knowledge base and model for cyber adversary behavior

claim: ATT&CK is derived from real-world observations
quote: MITRE ATT&CK is a globally-accessible knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques based on real-world observations.
issue: Abstract quote; the body is consistent, not narrower (its design principles require 'real-world use of activity through empirical use examples').

claim: ATT&CK was developed by the MITRE Corporation in 2013
quote: The first ATT&CK model was created in September 2013 and was primarily focused on the Windows enterprise environment.
issue: Created 2013, publicly released May 2015; 'developed ... in 2013' matches the creation date. MITRE authorship is from the report itself (a MITRE product).
